extract_match_from_images: extract feature matches and keypoints from a list of image paths or an image folder using SuperPoint and SuperGlue
convert_colmap_keypoints_to_pytorch3d: convert COLMAP keypoints and matches to PyTorch3D format using bounding box and scale information
run_hloc_pipeline: run the HLoc feature extraction and matching pipeline on images in a directory using SuperPoint and SuperGlue
compute_matches_and_keypoints: compute geometrically verified matches and keypoints from HLoc features and matches using COLMAP database
parse_blob_to_numpy_array: safely parse a binary blob into a numpy array with a specified dtype and shape
